name: Aibou
author: satoshoe
description: Control Center tile and settings for Aibou, small companions that live behind your windows on niri: they walk along the frame, melt into it while you work, climb, play with each other and dance to music. Aibou itself runs as its own Quickshell service from the same repository; see its README. The service follows niri's events, the pointer, CPU load, the battery, music players and the lock state. With "Feels the machine" (on by default) it also follows the system journal for crashes and failed services, and DMS's log. Off by default: "Notifications" reads the text of every notification; "Notices what happens" watches ~/Downloads, USB drives, microphone use and the names of running programs, and runs checkupdates. "In the bar: face only" takes a screenshot of the bar to find a free spot. None of this leaves the computer. The chat sends your messages to Anthropic through the claude CLI (optional) or to an API you set up; with "Desktop help", off by default, it also sends the config files it reads and may propose commands that run only when you click them. A chat line starting with ! runs in bash, as in a terminal.
